fullContentHtml:
UPESSC UP Assistant Professor Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the re open notification for the post of Assistant Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 1936 posts. Online applying process for UPESSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 has started from 08 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 07 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPESSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 September 2026
  • Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Correction Date : 11 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 19-20 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1500/-
  • PH : Rs. 1000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
